subject.title: fix(security): add default pidsLimit for sandbox containers

question: Should OpenClaw make a positive Docker sandbox `pidsLimit` the default for existing unset configs, and what opt-out/docs/tests are required before that ships?
rationale: The source-reproducible security hardening is useful, but changing an effective sandbox default can break existing deployments and needs owner approval of the security-versus-compatibility tradeoff.

options.title: Approve default with upgrade proof
options.body: Keep the default-on PID cap only after schema/type/docs/tests and real Docker proof show fresh and upgrade behavior plus explicit override semantics.

options.title: Keep default unset
options.body: Close or rework this PR to preserve current upgrade behavior and document operator-configured `pidsLimit` instead.

options.title: Make strict cap opt-in
options.body: Use an explicit strict profile or setting if maintainers want the mitigation without changing existing unset deployments.

recommendation.title: Approve default with upgrade proof
recommendation.body: Keep the default-on PID cap only after schema/type/docs/tests and real Docker proof show fresh and upgrade behavior plus explicit override semantics.

likelyOwner.reason: CODEOWNERS assigns the affected sandbox and security-doc surfaces to this team, and the decision is a sandbox security boundary default.
